entities.name: Nath
entities.description: A ruthless taercenn of the Gilt-Leaf hunters who hid his aged, ugly true form behind a glamer and was killed by Rhys.

entities.name: Gilt-Leaf
entities.description: The elvish tribe and empire that Nath served as taercenn.

entities.name: Daen Rhys
aliases: Daen Rhys of the Hemlock pack
entities.description: A Gilt-Leaf daen of the Hemlock pack who opposed the slaughter of boggarts and killed Nath.

entities.name: Daen Gryffid
entities.description: Rhys's second-in-command who took over the Hemlock pack, allied with Nath and swore revenge on Rhys.

entities.name: Yelm
entities.description: A young hunter killed by Nath for loosing an arrow prematurely.

entities.name: Hemlock pack
entities.description: A Gilt-Leaf hunting pack commanded by Rhys, then Gryffid.

entities.name: Porringer Valley
entities.description: Valley where the Feast of Footbottom was attacked.

entities.name: Feast of Footbottom
entities.description: A peaceful boggart festival that Nath ordered ambushed.

entities.name: Boggarts
entities.description: Goblin-like creatures attacked by the Gilt-Leaf hunters.

entities.name: Kinsbaile
entities.description: Kithkin settlement where Nath ambushed Rhys during the Festival of Tales.

entities.name: Festival of Tales
entities.description: Festival during which Nath came to Kinsbaile.

entities.name: Gaddock Teeg
entities.description: Incompetent local leader of Kinsbaile who fell to Nath's order.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: The plane where the events take place.

entities.name: Blessed Nation
entities.description: The elvish empire from which Nath hid his appearance.

events.summary: Nath punishes Daen Rhys for the failed boggart raid, kills Yelm, demotes Rhys and gives the Hemlock pack to Gryffid.
events.quote: He plunged his sword into the still-living skull of Yelm

events.summary: Nath orders the full Gilt-Leaf hunters to attack the boggarts at the Feast of Footbottom over Rhys's objections.
events.quote: Nath ordered the full strength of the Gilt-Leaf hunters to attack boggarts converging in the Porringer Valley

events.summary: The boggarts fight back; Rhys unleashes yew poison magic that wipes out nearly all combatants, leaving Rhys, Gryffid and Nath alive and Nath's glamer failed.
events.quote: The resulting blast defiled a huge portion of the forest and wiped out the combatants

events.summary: Gryffid sees Nath's true form and chooses to keep his secret; Nath heals and promotes him.
events.quote: After Gryffid chose to ally himself, Nath healed him and promoted him to the exquisite class.

events.summary: Nath and Gryffid come to Kinsbaile to ambush Rhys, planning to annex it.
events.quote: Nath and Gryffid came to Kinsbaile in pursuit of Rhys

events.summary: Nath challenges Rhys to a duel; Rhys flees, is wounded by the cuffhounds, and kills Nath in hand-to-hand combat, his glamer failing at death.
events.quote: Rhys emerged victorious when he gripped Nath's horns and twisted them

events.summary: Gryffid finds Nath's body, sets up a funeral pyre, takes his silver sword and swears to kill Rhys.
events.quote: Gryffid set up a funeral pyre for Nath, took his silver sword

events.summary: Rhys raises Nath's broken horn and tells the hunters to keep Nath's true appearance from the Blessed Nation.
events.quote: Rhys, victorious on the field of battle, raised the taercenn's broken horn

relations.quote: until he snapped his neck and broke off one of his horns

relations.note: Nath killed Yelm for a mistake
relations.quote: He plunged his sword into the still-living skull of Yelm
Nath was a taercenn of the Gilt-Leaf hunters.

relations.note: Chose to ally himself with Nath
relations.quote: After Gryffid chose to ally himself
he would find Rhys and kill him for this
